takeaways: A tenant is a security boundary, and most companies own more tenants than they realise through mergers, subsidiaries, test environments and shadow IT.
Microsoft Entra Tenant Governance discovers related tenants from B2B, multi-tenant app and billing signals, then brings the ones you keep under governance relationships and configuration monitoring.
Cross-tenant access settings, administrative units and guest invitation settings control who reaches what, and their open defaults deserve a deliberate review.
hook: Many companies own far more Microsoft 365 tenants than anyone has on a list, and the forgotten ones are the riskiest. This beginner-friendly episode is for IT admins and decision makers who want to understand Microsoft Entra tenant governance. You will learn how to find related tenants, govern the ones you keep and tighten cross-tenant and guest defaults safely.
